req.title: Cookies-set returns Set-Cookie per entry
req.statement: The system shall emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair passed to /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies/set must emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair. The set_cookies() handler iterates request.args and calls r.set_cookie() for each pair. Tests must verify: (1) positive - two params produce exactly two Set-Cookie headers with correct names/values; (2) negative - zero params produce zero Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary - exactly one param produces exactly one Set-Cookie header (BVA at n=1). Additional tests cover exact header count, exact cookie values, and the redirect status code to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
expected: Exactly two Set-Cookie headers are present
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: one Set-Cookie per k=v pair
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    joined = ' '.join(set_cookie_headers)
    assert 'a=1' in joined
    assert 'b=2' in joined

test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers()

tests.name: test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Two distinct k=v pairs with non-trivial values
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: each Set-Cookie must bind the correct value to the correct name
Catches mutations that swap key/value assignment in set_cookie()
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=hello&bar=world', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    has_foo_hello = any('foo=hello' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    has_bar_world = any('bar=world' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    has_foo_world = any('foo=world' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    has_bar_hello = any('bar=hello' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    assert has_foo_hello is True
    assert has_bar_world is True
    assert has_foo_world is False
    assert has_bar_hello is False

test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client with follow_redirects=True
Parse JSON body of final /cookies response
expected: Final response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: end-to-end state transition: set -> redirect -> view
Verifies cookies are actually stored and readable after redirect
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_set_followed_redirect_reflects_cookies_in_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=10&beta=20', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'cookies' in body
    cookies = body['cookies']
    assert cookies.get('alpha') == '10'
    assert cookies.get('beta') == '20'

test_cookies_set_followed_redirect_reflects_cookies_in_json()
